triggers.definicion: CREATE TRIGGER trg_next_entry_number BEFORE INSERT ON public.accounting_entries FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION next_entry_number()
CREATE TRIGGER order_items_pin_price BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.order_items FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION pin_order_item_price()
CREATE TRIGGER order_items_recalc_total AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.order_items FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION recalc_order_total()
CREATE TRIGGER set_payments_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.payments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION handle_updated_at()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_sync_product_title_name BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.products FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sync_product_title_name()
CREATE TRIGGER sale_items_apply_stock AFTER INSERT ON public.sale_items FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION apply_sale_stock()
